xmldoc.short_description: Sequential feature selection using a custom criterion.

syntax.syntax_item: tf = sequentialfs(fun, X1, ..., XN, Name, Value)

description.p: sequentialfs selects features from the columns of the first data input using a user supplied criterion function.
Supported options include CV, Direction, KeepIn, KeepOut, NFeatures, NullModel, and Options. CV can be a positive integer, none, or resubstitution.
The history structure contains In and Crit fields describing the selected feature mask and criterion value at each step.
